title: Stochastic Replay Audit for Quantization Rollouts with Context-Aware Gates
creator: Ava Patel
description: Build an automated 'stochastic replay' validation harness that applies FP8/INT8 quantization profiles and calibration transforms to sampled production-like traffic, then evaluates accuracy and fidelity using contextual, instruction-aware metrics. The harness will support: deterministic seeding for reproducible failure repros; paraphrase-based golden-set augmentation to expand coverage; per-layer activation drift capture; and an ensemble rollback matrix that recommends safe fallbacks when gates fail. This ticket covers design, implementation, and an initial canary run against a subset of models and customer traffic cohorts.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can replay sampled traffic with deterministic seeding and apply a chosen quant profile (FP8/INT8) and calibration recipe
Compute and persist per-request metrics: token-level perplexity delta, instruction-following F1, semantic-similarity (SBERT cosine), and output KL divergence versus reference distribution
Context-aware pass/fail gate triggers when any metric exceeds configured delta thresholds per-cohort, and produces a human-readable rollback recommendation
Paraphrase-augmented golden set increases false-negative detection by >=15% versus baseline static goldens in internal tests
End-to-end canary run executed for 3 models with telemetry surfaced in a console dashboard and an automated Slack alert hook

notes: Design decisions: use ensemble of metrics instead of single-score gating. Rationale: single metric (e.g., perplexity) misses instruction-following regressions.
Trade-offs: paraphrase augmentation increases coverage but adds variance; we apply calibrated thresholds per-cohort and require multi-metric agreement before failing a rollout.
Fallback behavior: when gate fires, harness will suggest fallback to last-known-good quant profile, or to higher-precision variant (FP16) on affected shard(s), with estimated cost delta computed.
